newsitem.title: DENMARK: DANISH CENTRAL BANK BUYS BACK CDS AT 3.50 PCT.
newsitem.headline: DANISH CENTRAL BANK BUYS BACK CDS AT 3.50 PCT.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Wednesday that it offered to buy back 14-day certificates of deposit (CDs) at a fixed yield of 3.50 percent plus the normal 0.05 percent buyback charge, unchanged from the previous two-week offer.
The bank steers money market rates and liquidity through its 14-day certificates of deposit (CDs) deals and state paper repos.
The central bank discount and key deposit rates were unchanged at 3.25 percent. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969652
